## Summary

Provide a concise description of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Related Issue

Closes #

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user-facing functionality
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring code without functional changes
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, build, or tooling update
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated test coverage

## Checklist

- [ ] Code conforms to repository formatting and lint rules (`bun run check`)
- [ ] Tests have been executed locally and pass
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] Commit messages adhere to Conventional Commits
- [ ] No automated co-author attributions included
